about: How sure Penthera's rank is on each public benchmark (E11b test half). Exploratory: computed after the registered analysis, which ranks by point score.
method: Each ranked tool's counts are redrawn 10,000 times as independent binomials (a parametric bootstrap); SecBench.js resamples its 64 test bugs instead, paired across tools. rank is the 95% interval of Penthera's rank over the redraws; first is the share of redraws in which Penthera alone scored highest.
source: paper/analysis/posthoc.mjs, methods paper (branch docs/methods-paper, 25 Oct 2026), run on bench/public/published.json of 2026-10-25
